background: Close Brothers Group is a UK merchant banking group, funded by retail and corporate deposits and lending on motor finance, asset finance, invoice finance and property development.
synthesis: Both agencies hold the group on a negative outlook, Fitch at BBB and Moody's at Baa2 after its downgrade to Baa2 on 17 Oct 2025, and that is the weakest part of the picture. The balance sheet itself is liquid and lightly levered: leverage of 12.9%, LCR of 1012% and NSFR of 146% are all in the top quarter of UK mid-sized banks. CET1 of 13.8% is the single measure below the peer median, which set against that leverage ratio points to dense risk weights on the lending book rather than a thin capital base. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
